provenance.canonicalisation: RFC 8785 JCS via scripts/jcs.py; set hash is SHA-256 over JCS(vectors).
provenance.signatures: Ed25519 over domain || lowercase SHA-256 hex using fixed public test seeds; dependency-free RFC 8032 verifier.
provenance.status: candidate — no Demos runtime guarantee and no second-implementation cross-run yet
provenance.syntheticProofProfile: demos-bft-proof/test-1 fixtures define outputHash as SHA-256(JCS(storageOutput)), SHA-256(JCS(native transfer payload)), or SHA-256(JCS({accepted:true,operationId})); effectsRoot is SHA-256(JCS({pre,post})). These are test-only formulas, not production Demos wire claims.

coverage.note: ruleRefs provide rule-ID coverage; absence from a polarity set is an explicit conformance gap, not implicit coverage.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-exact-profile
vectors.reason: Signed Vet artifacts, existing agreement, commitment, slot and payment follow the exact profile.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-authenticated-pay-dem
vectors.reason: Atomic Purchase cannot select another rail phase or mismatch its signed phase tuple.

vectors.name: awp-vet-signature-mutation
vectors.reason: Vet bytes and signature are verified, not trusted as a detached verdict.

vectors.name: awp-vet-cf4-address-mismatch
vectors.reason: A Vet write must use the CF-4 encoded CompositeVerificationRecord address.

vectors.name: awp-vet-cas-forbidden
vectors.reason: Atomic Purchase may create a Vet record but cannot CAS-rewrite it.

vectors.name: awp-live-vet-action
vectors.reason: Nondeterministic live Vet action cannot execute in the rollback overlay.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-order-changed
vectors.reason: Payment cannot move before the signed commitment/slot ordering.

vectors.name: awp-commitment-agreement-binding
vectors.reason: The commitment must bind the accepted agreement before payment.

vectors.name: awp-commitment-cas-forbidden
vectors.reason: The commitment gate requires the canonical create-only dacs3 address.

vectors.name: awp-commitment-job-binding
vectors.reason: A valid commitment carrying another jobId cannot be used by this Purchase Work.

vectors.name: awp-commitment-listing-binding
vectors.reason: A valid commitment must repeat the exact listingRef pinned by the signed agreement.

vectors.name: awp-consensus-deadline
vectors.reason: All commitment checks use the timestamp committed in the BFT Work receipt.

vectors.name: awp-deadline-expired
vectors.reason: Consensus block time outside notAfter rejects payment.

vectors.name: awp-client-time-not-authoritative
vectors.reason: Client/RPC observation time cannot replace the finalized block timestamp.

vectors.name: awp-cofinal-critical-effects
vectors.reason: Commitment, slot and payment share one commit outcome and BFT receipt.

vectors.name: awp-partial-critical-effect
vectors.reason: Mixed critical outcomes violate co-finality.

vectors.name: awp-sequential-gate-when-proof-missing
vectors.reason: Without common BFT receipt the atomic alternative is unavailable and sequential CA-1/SR2-8 applies.

vectors.name: awp-completion-exact-profile
vectors.reason: Completion verifies Purchase receipt then writes exact delivery bytes; evidence remains for the tail.

vectors.name: awp-completion-commitment-projection-missing
vectors.reason: Completion cannot execute until the Purchase commitment storage operation has a finalized complete AnchorReceipt projection.

vectors.name: awp-completion-commitment-projection-mismatch
vectors.reason: A contradictory Purchase commitment AnchorReceipt cannot satisfy the Completion gate.

vectors.name: awp-completion-authenticated-delivery
vectors.reason: Completion delivery phase index must match the verified signed Listing invocation while retaining the Purchase slot phase.

vectors.name: awp-delivery-content-mismatch
vectors.reason: Delivery bytes must match the agreed content hash.

vectors.name: awp-delivery-address-mismatch
vectors.reason: Completion delivery must use dacs4:deliverable:{jobId}.

vectors.name: awp-delivery-cas-forbidden
vectors.reason: Atomic Completion delivery is create-only and cannot CAS-rewrite a prior artifact.

vectors.name: awp-completion-does-not-finalize-bundle
vectors.reason: Completion inclusion alone is not a DACS-5 finalization proof.

vectors.name: awp-post-purchase-failure-placeholder
vectors.reason: A Boolean cannot establish a verified role-specific DACS failure record.

vectors.name: awp-refund-amendment-placeholder
vectors.reason: A generic artifact is not a versioned SettlementAmendment and does not prove the original evidence publication.

vectors.name: awp-unlinked-refund
vectors.reason: An unlinked correction cannot mutate original settlement history.

vectors.name: awp-fair-exchange-profile-placeholder
vectors.reason: The amendment does not fabricate an escrow profile that has not been standardized.

vectors.name: awp-fair-exchange-claim-without-profile
vectors.reason: Atomic Work alone does not provide fair exchange between Purchase and Completion.
